summary: Alternate spread/total feature tested end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest pass (alt_spread/alt_total in NFL/NBA/EPL, no quarter lines, home/away mirror, unique side+line, gzip Content-Encoding, single + parlay with alt legs placed, tampered alt odds -> 409 with changed[], nonexistent alt line -> 409 unavailable[], two alt lines on same market in one parlay -> 400, bets history contains alt legs, settle_selection alt_spread/alt_total incl. whole-number push). Frontend: sliders render on every MatchCard starting at main line, keyboard (Arrow/Home/End) and mouse drag (mobile 390px) update line value + odds buttons, 'Not offered' shown when a side is missing, add/replace ('Alternate line updated')/toggle-off work, parlay (alt_spread+alt_total+ML) and single (alt_total) placed through UI with balance update and My Bets showing legs. Regression OK: main spread/total/ML buttons, player props toggle, boosts strip, UFC cards (no alt sliders, More markets shows only rounds/distance). One real bug found: 409 price-change/unavailable handling does not update alt legs in the slip.

minor.issue: Same line priced differently in main vs alt market (alt uses median across books, main uses consensus): e.g. BOS -5.5 main 1.87 vs alt 1.93; CL Over 6.5 main 5.01 vs alt 6.00; O 222.5 1.85 vs 1.83. User can cherry-pick the better price for the identical bet.

_market_key treats 'spread' and 'alt_spread' (and total/alt_total) as different markets, so a parlay can combine NYK -4.5 (main) + NYK -6 (alt) or even the identical line from both markets on the same game. Verified in UI slip (SGP accepted). Consider keying alt_spread->spread and alt_total->total for conflict detection.
Median-per-line can produce non-monotonic ladders (NFL CHI -27 @21.0 vs CHI -27.5 @19.0, easier line paying more). Consider sanity filter/monotonic smoothing.

integration_issues.flow: Bet placement 409 (odds changed / line pulled) with alt legs
integration_issues.issue: BetSlipContext.applyServerPrices builds key `${event_id}:${market}:${side}` but selId() for alt_ markets appends `:${line}`, and backend 'changed'/'unavailable' entries carry no line. Result: for alt legs the slip is NOT repriced and pulled alt lines are NOT removed; user sees the warning toast but resubmitting loops on 409. Reproduced by intercepting POST /api/bets with a 409 changed payload: alt_total leg stayed 1.93 (no prev-odds / changed note) while a main total leg updated 1.89->1.50 correctly. Fix: include `line` in backend changed/unavailable dicts and use selId() in applyServerPrices.

issues: Value label always says 'pts' (e.g. '3.5 pts', '6.5 pts') even for goal-based sports; use 'goals' or just the number
With 80-100 lines (NBA/NFL) a short drag jumps ~10 lines; consider +/- step buttons beside the slider for fine control
Alt total slider on live CL game (score 4-2) ranged 6.5-9.5 with odds consistent; fine, but min line label can sit below current total on live events if feed lags

action_items: Fix applyServerPrices key mismatch for alt_ legs (include line in backend _verify_selections changed/unavailable and match via selId) so 409 repricing/removal works for alternate lines
Treat spread/alt_spread and total/alt_total as the same underlying market for conflict detection (backend _market_key and frontend baseKey) to block correlated/duplicate legs
Align alt price for the main line with the main market price (or hide the main line from the alt ladder) to avoid two prices for one bet
Optional: unit label 'goals' for soccer/hockey alt totals; +/- step buttons on slider
